assumptions.source_interval_reconstruction: The geometric midpoint and log SE are working approximations from source bounds, not reported point estimates or raw-data fit.
assumptions.period_alignment: Uniform daily allocation within each calendar year, annualised to source 365-day equivalents. Nominal survey periods do not assert exact participant dates.
assumptions.calibration: Source uplift is removed before fitting. Alternative uplifts and common errors map posterior paths; they are not learned from the same supply/survey source.
assumptions.stocks: Opening stocks at the first release rate; closing stocks at the current release rate. Explicit scenarios, no observed inventory.
assumptions.origin: No positive-part truncation, illegality probability, organised-crime harm, QALYs or funding recommendation is derived.
assumptions.time: Prospective ratios after 2023 are extrapolations; newer reported tonnes do not supply a compatible cigarette-equivalent denominator.
